Another clip from a debate I joined on PBS’s Breaking the Deadlock.
 
The question: With all the political division, institutional distrust, and challenges we face today – does America have what it takes to survive another 250 years?
 
Here’s my answer. America has been tested before, and those tests have made us stronger, not weaker.
 
What do you think? Will America make it another 250 years?

Lindsey Graham was an old-school statesman – a rare thing in politics today. Charming and quick-witted, but always serious when it mattered.
 
And he never wavered in his belief that America must lead the world, stand by its allies, and defeat its enemies. 
 
Rest in peace, Lindsey. You will be missed.

Share this with anyone who’s been duped by the 1619 Project’s version of America’s founding.
 
Constitutional law scholar @RandyEBarnett explains why the historical record is far more complicated than the claim that America was founded to preserve slavery: at the time of the founding, America was on the leading edge of the anti-slavery movement, and the prevailing expectation at the time was that slavery was already on a path toward abolition. 
 
From the latest Hold These Truths podcast.
